channel-type.label: Loop Ratio
channel-type.description: Time the device was occupied by this connection during the last poll, in percent of the refresh interval

channel-type.label: Loop Ratio Average
channel-type.description: Average loop ratio over the last 20 polls

channel-type.label: Loop Ratio Peak
channel-type.description: Highest loop ratio of the last 20 polls

channel-type.label: Poll Duration
channel-type.description: Time the last request spent on the wire, from sending to the complete answer

channel-type.label: Device Wait
channel-type.description: Time the device needed to start its answer to the last request

channel-type.label: Dispatch Time
channel-type.description: Time openHAB needed to hand the answer of the last poll to the things

channel-type.label: Answer Size
channel-type.description: Size of the answer to the last request
